name: Smooth-L1 + Spatial + Temporal Gradients
tagline: Smooth-L1 latent matching plus Smooth-L1 on spatial finite-difference gradients (H, W) and on temporal differences.
formula:
$$ \mathcal{L} = \mathrm{SL1}(z, \hat z) + \lambda_s \big(\mathrm{SL1}(\Delta_H \hat z, \Delta_H z) + \mathrm{SL1}(\Delta_W \hat z, \Delta_W z)\big) + \lambda_t\,\mathrm{SL1}(\Delta_T \hat z, \Delta_T z) $$
$$ \mathrm{SL1}(a,b) = \overline{\begin{cases}0.5(a-b)^2 & |a-b|<1 \\ |a-b|-0.5 & \text{else}\end{cases}} $$
init_recovers: smooth_l1 baseline when both gradient weights → 0
diff_from_baseline: Adds two finite-difference Smooth-L1 terms (along H+W and along T) on top of the smooth_l1 baseline to encourage matching of spatial and temporal feature gradients.

name: MSE + Spatial/Temporal Grad + Std Match
tagline: MSE + spatial+temporal MSE-on-differences + L2 between spatial and temporal feature standard deviations.
formula:
$$ \mathcal{L} = \|z-\hat z\|_2^2 + w_{spat}\big(\|\Delta_H\hat z - \Delta_H z\|_2^2 + \|\Delta_W\hat z - \Delta_W z\|_2^2\big) + w_{temp}\,\|\Delta_T\hat z - \Delta_T z\|_2^2 $$
$$ + w_{\sigma_t}\,\|\sigma_T(\hat z) - \sigma_T(z)\|_2^2 + w_{\sigma_s}\,\|\sigma_{HW}(\hat z) - \sigma_{HW}(z)\|_2^2 $$
init_recovers: MSE baseline when all extra weights → 0
diff_from_baseline: Adds to the mse baseline (a) MSE on H, W, T finite-difference gradients with anisotropic weights and (b) two standard-deviation matching terms — one over the time axis, one over the (H,W) plane — to preserve temporal and spatial contrast.

name: Whitened Smooth-L1 + Hardness + ΔT + Cosine
tagline: Channel-whitened Smooth-L1 with detached per-step hardness re-weighting, plus temporal-difference Smooth-L1 and a small cosine term.
formula:
$$ \sigma_c = \sqrt{\mathrm{Var}_{B,T,H,W}(z) + \varepsilon}, \quad \tilde z = z/\sigma, \;\; \tilde p = \hat z/\sigma $$
$$ \ell_t = \overline{\mathrm{SL1}(\tilde p, \tilde z)}_{B,C,H,W}, \quad w_t = \Big(\tfrac{\mathrm{sg}(\ell_t)}{\overline{\mathrm{sg}(\ell)}+\varepsilon}\Big)^{1.5} \Big/ \overline{(\cdot)} $$
$$ \mathcal{L} = \overline{w_t \ell_t} + \lambda_\Delta\,\mathrm{SL1}(\Delta_T\tilde p, \Delta_T\tilde z) + \lambda_c\big(1 - \overline{\cos(\mathrm{flat}\tilde p, \mathrm{flat}\tilde z)}\big) $$

key_hyperparams.name: ε
key_hyperparams.role: scale floor for whitening / weight normalisation

init_recovers: smooth_l1 baseline at focus=0, delta_weight=0, cosine_weight=0
diff_from_baseline: Goes well beyond the smooth_l1 baseline: divides features by per-channel std, computes Smooth-L1 per timestep, re-weights timesteps by detached hardness^1.5, and adds a temporal-difference Smooth-L1 plus a small cosine-similarity term over flattened spatio-temporal slices.

name: Edge-weighted Huber + Cosine + ΔT Huber
tagline: Pixelwise Huber re-weighted by target spatial-gradient magnitude, plus per-pixel cosine across channels and a temporal Huber.
formula:
$$ w_{b,t,h,w} = \overline{|\Delta_W z|}_C + \overline{|\Delta_H z|}_C \;\;(\text{padded to } H\!\times\!W),\;\; \tilde w = w \cdot \tfrac{BCTHW}{\sum w + \varepsilon} $$
$$ \mathcal{L} = \alpha\,\overline{\tilde w \cdot \mathrm{Huber}_1(z, \hat z)} + \beta\,\overline{1 - \cos_C(z_{:,c,t,h,w}, \hat z_{:,c,t,h,w})} + \gamma\,\mathrm{Huber}_1(\Delta_T \hat z, \Delta_T z) $$
init_recovers: uniform-weighted Huber + cosine + ΔT-Huber when α dominates and edge mask becomes uniform
diff_from_baseline: Replaces plain MSE/cosine with a Huber loss whose pixel weights come from the L1-averaged spatial gradient of the target latent (focus on 'edge' pixels), and adds a per-pixel channel-direction cosine term and a temporal-difference Huber.

name: Unmodified template (zero loss)
tagline: Returned the scaffold's placeholder loss unchanged: a constant 0.0 with requires_grad=True.
diff_from_baseline: No actual loss is implemented — the agent left the CustomPredictionLoss template untouched, so training receives no prediction-loss gradient (only the VICReg regularizer and the auxiliary recon/det probes drive the encoder).
